basic_info.description: Serene oasis on a corner lot at the cusp of Noe Valley and Glen Pk. Renovated to the studs, this 2 lvl, 2BDR/2BA designer Vic home is everything you want! Open floor plan w soaring ceilings, bay windows, and period dets. Open kitchen, dining and living spaces, bathed in natural light-perfect for entertaining! Professional, eat-in kitchen opens to sun-drenched deck and offers Carrera marble and soapstone countertops, SubZero refrigerator, Fisher Paykel double dishwasher drawers, Wolf six-burner gas cooktop, Thermador double oven, Heath Ceramics tile backsplash, custom Fieldstone Cabinetry, and a breakfast bar w ample seating. Dining space w period built-in cabinet, lined w south-facing windows overlooking the garden. A spacious BDR, and a Carrera marble full BA. Upstairs, a sumptuous primary suite w walk-in closet and a Carrera marble, tiled bath, Restoration Hardware vanity, and in-wall speakers. Flex space just outside the primary could be a nursery, home office, yoga studio or den. Janet Moyer designed designed, south-facing garden. Huge interior access garage + expansion pot'l. New steel-reinforced concrete foundation (2007). New high-end roof (2023). New furnace (2018). Steps to the Apple shuttle/tech coaches, the J-Church, and flat walk to 24th St/Church shops, cafes. Wow!
